_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in an {num_players}-player Liar's Dice game.
Rules:
- On your turn, you may either:
  1) Make a new bid with a higher quantity or higher face (or both) than the current bid; i.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Call the last bid by typing '[Call]'.

If you call:
  - If the actual count of that face value among all dice is less than the bid, the last bidder loses one die.
  - Otherwise, the caller loses one die.
A player who reaches 0 dice is eliminated. The last remaining player wins.

board.new_round:
Mzunguko mpya - Fafi zilizobaki: {dice_summary}
Fafi zako za sasa ni: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Mchezaji {current_player_id} anaita! Idadi halisi ya uso {face_value} ni {count}, ambayo ni NYOI kuliko {quantity}.
Mchezaji {loser_id} (mabidi ya mwisho) anapoteza fafi moja.
call.caller_loses:
Mchezaji {current_player_id} anaita! Idadi halisi ya uso {face_value} ni {count}, ambayo ni >= {quantity}.
Mchezaji {loser_id} (muitaji) anapoteza fafi moja.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Ndyaĩ na nzika kana nĩw'o waĩ ũndũ ũla wa vata vyũ.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Hatua siyo imeambatana kama '[Bid: X, Y]' au '[Call]' halali. Hatua iliyowasilishwa: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Kiasi kipya {new_quantity} ni cha chini kuliko cha sasa {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Thamani mpya ya uso {new_face_value} ni ya chini kuliko ile ya sasa {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Kĩvĩla kĩla kyakwatie kĩthĩawa kĩvw'anene na kya ũla mũkũũ.
bid_reason.face_range: No nginya woneke wĩ kĩvathũkany'o na woo.

message.eliminated_invalid: Mũthaũki {player_id} aumisye ĩvia na ĩtina esa kũtũngwa ĩngĩ.
